name: F126-R depth-invariant contrastive raw-binding evidence
scope: New independent frozen scientific-development candidate, not F126 autonomy branch, not F124-E key-value-memory branch. No model/source generator exists at this preregistration.

retained_negatives.F125R_training_balance: Positive and negative correctness sum to chance-level; depth 3 mostly positive and depth 4/5 mostly negative regardless of causal pair.
retained_negatives.F125R_interpretation: No K2 truncation: path-preserving saved weights still assign negative graphs higher probability for every paired TRAIN example. Neither rethresholding nor arbitrary widening counts as repair.
retained_negatives.parallel_F124E_capacity32_diagnostic: Restores valid route retention but not learned paired discrimination; exploratory, not accepted

hypothesis.mechanism: Learn public raw-token adjacency log-evidence from signed bitwise interactions, subtract a deterministic graph-matched label-blind token-scramble reference, and aggregate path evidence after normalizing by public candidate count and reasoning length. A pairwise contrastive objective makes matched true/false graph separation primary instead of the thresholded total route mass.
hypothesis.weights: 16 raw signed bit interactions + one local bias + one bounded length-evidence scale + output gain + output cutoff
hypothesis.training_loss: Full-batch balanced matched-pair logistic ranking loss plus 0.5*BCE, fixed coefficient and frozen optimizer initialization. No post-result changes.
hypothesis.negative_reference: Exactly one canonical label-blind rotated source-token reference per observed graph generated using source-only hash of public graph, identical processing for both labels, never seed or oracle path.
hypothesis.inference_input: Single public observation only; no paired negative or phase label at inference
hypothesis.symmetry: Input permutation/node renaming invariance with deterministic public canonicalization, pairwise shared topology and token marginal retention
hypothesis.normalization: Normalize signed log-evidence per traversed raw-token binding and correct for public path count; no depth-only intercept label shortcut
hypothesis.forbidden: No hard K2 pruning, engineered exact-equality oracle feature, hidden selected route, original F125R learned weights, protected CONFIRM, train-test leakage, retrospective winner selection
hypothesis.cost_limits: <= 20 trainable parameters; <= 256 public states and 512 candidate expansions per public graph; overbudget is failure not selective dataset exclusion
hypothesis.ablation: Freeze baseline no graph-specific null subtraction and separate no length-normalization, compare on exactly same cohort (diagnostic only; any result is not a preapproval)

prospective_evaluation.raw_16bit_salt: fresh F126R graph-local salt, no F123/F124R/F125R salt reuse
prospective_evaluation.exact_symbolic_control: MANDATORY ELIGIBLE information-matched baseline whenever it reads the same public bits; it must NEVER be excluded to manufacture headroom. Report its accuracy AND its reproducible runtime/operation cost.
prospective_evaluation.headroom_rule: No fixed-control headroom selection or source reseeding is permitted after source evaluation. Report exact and all other controls on every case. No scientific success can be inferred from beating an intentionally weak heuristic.
prospective_evaluation.scientific_primary: Independent structural transfer: on separately eligible protected CONFIRM, learned paired correctness >= 0.90 of eligible exact-public symbolic and beats strongest non-oracle eligible control without depth-stratum regression, with correct pairwise ranking >= .90.
prospective_evaluation.cost_requirement: No more than 0.75 of exact-public symbolic comparator primitive operations on the same graphs under a shared accounting definition, including public adjacency build, hashing/sort, scans, token bit operations, gradients and allocations. Wallclock same runner plus memory usage as separate evidence.
prospective_evaluation.no_unearned_fitness: If exact solver is both more accurate and no more expensive, result FAILS; no symbolic ceiling loophole. Training alone can never establish scientific transfer.
prospective_evaluation.train_only_diagnostics: Frozen TRAIN scores, signed pairwise ranking by depth, null intervention, complete primitive-event accounting and SHA identity are developmental evidence ONLY.

science_governance.current_gate: Freeze this independent hypothesis and validate immutable source contract on Ubuntu and Windows. No F126R model, source cohort cases, or scientific original generated.
science_governance.next_gate: Implement and test public synthetic TRAIN-only source generator and contrastive mechanism; source-verify both lanes. Run controlled original only after separately authenticated first-use approval.
